expansion_rules.digest: An object with sole key $digest and one lowercase hex character expands to that character repeated 64 times.
expansion_rules.vector: An object with sole key $vector expands to the eight-field resource vector with the named field overrides and zero elsewhere.
expansion_rules.thinking_controls: An object with sole key $thinking_controls expands in customization-row-major/control-minor order to the complete ten-source by four-control sample inventory; mode selects the single explicit provider-request control and optional mutations remove a source or add a manual conflict.
expansion_rules.customization_record: An object with sole key $customization_record expands to a self-digested two-row customization record or one named duplicate/path-alias/shadowed/post-scan mutation.
expansion_rules.attempt_join: An object with sole key $attempt_join expands to the complete reservation-entry-envelope-consumption-observation equality surface with one optional named mutation.
expansion_rules.attempt_entry_lifecycle: An object with sole key $attempt_entry_lifecycle expands to self-digested generation, RESERVED, LAUNCH_CONSUMED, and RECONCILED entries plus reserve/consume/reconcile events, envelope, and observation, with optional post-digest/predecessor/allocation/use mutations.
expansion_rules.customization_join: An object with sole key $customization_join expands to a separately self-digested discovery authority, the self-digested customization set, and effort/thinking/launch row projections, with optional missing/extra source mutations.
expansion_rules.thinking_launch_join: An object with sole key $thinking_launch_join expands to a self-digested Claude provider-control vector, thinking authority, launch authority, and attempt envelope with one optional vector, argv, or environment mutation.
expansion_rules.canary_chain: An object with sole key $canary_chain expands to a self-digested case-result, evidence-manifest, field-claim, and receipt chain with one optional named mutation.
expansion_rules.budget_chain: An object with sole key $budget_chain expands to a self-digested token derivation and BudgetAuthorityV3 chain with one optional named mutation.
expansion_rules.budget_ledger_join: An object with sole key $budget_ledger_join expands to a self-digested derivation, budget authority, genesis ledger prestate, and RESERVE_GENERATION event with one optional delta, prestate, or budget mutation.
expansion_rules.ledger_event: An object with sole key $ledger_event expands to a self-digested RELEASE_ATTEMPT, MARK_RESERVED_ATTEMPT_DEBT, or MARK_CONSUMED_ATTEMPT_DEBT event with optional launch mutations.
expansion_rules.ledger_snapshot: An object with sole key $ledger_snapshot expands to a self-digested revision-one snapshot with one optional previous/sequence/membership/count mutation.
expansion_rules.observation: An object with sole key $observation expands to a self-digested execution observation in confirmed, unobservable, not-applicable, or confirmed-with-null-evidence mode.
expansion_rules.observation_disposition: An object with sole key $observation_disposition expands to a self-digested observation and either a confirmed reconciliation disposition or an exact route-debt plus consumed-attempt-debt event, with optional adverse direct-reconcile/evidence/launch mutations.
expansion_rules.self_digest: A direct record member whose value is {$self_digest: member_name} is replaced after nested expansion with lowercase SHA-256 of canonical record bytes with that member omitted.
expansion_rules.customization_authority_digests: {$customization_registry_digest:true} hashes the fixed source-kind/rank table; {$customization_discovery_digest:true} hashes the root, registry, expected count, and ordered source projection before the containing self digest.
